contractValidation.scope: Local JSON Schema draft 2020-12 components and development examples; not full OpenAPI conformance validation and not a deployed API call.
contractValidation.recordingNote: Recorded after the already observed successful validation; validation was not repeated when writing this record.
contractValidation.shellInvocation: PowerShell here-string containing stdinScript, piped to python -
contractValidation.stdinScript:
import copy,json
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator

base=Path('.agents/agent-platform/contracts/v1')
oas=json.loads((base/'capabilities.openapi.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
examples=json.loads((base/'capabilities.examples.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
core=json.loads((base/'core.schema.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert oas['openapi']=='3.1.0'
assert list(oas['paths'])==['/api/agent-platform/capabilities']
operation=oas['paths']['/api/agent-platform/capabilities']
assert list(operation)==['get'] and operation['get']['security']==[]
assert list(operation['get']['responses'])==['200']
assert 'X-Oneapi-Request-Id' in operation['get']['responses']['200']['headers']
schemas=copy.deepcopy(oas['components']['schemas'])
for schema in schemas.values():
    Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
schemas['DisabledAdmissionError']['allOf'][0]['$ref']='#/$defs/errorResponse'

def validator(name):
    root={'$schema':'https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema','$defs':core['$defs'],'components':{'schemas':schemas},'$ref':'#/components/schemas/'+name}
    Draft202012Validator.check_schema(root)
    return Draft202012Validator(root)

valid=0
for case in examples['cases']:
    status=case['response']['status']
    schema='CapabilityProbeResponse' if status==200 else 'DisabledAdmissionError'
    validator(schema).validate(case['response']['body'])
    assert case['response']['headers']['Cache-Control']=='no-store'
    assert case['response']['headers']['X-Oneapi-Request-Id']==case['response']['body']['request_id']
    if status==200:
        inline=operation['get']['responses']['200']['content']['application/json']['examples'][case['name']]['value']
        assert inline==case['response']['body']
    else:
        assert case['registered_operation'] is False and case['request']['method']=='POST'
    valid+=1
probe=validator('CapabilityProbeResponse')
fixture=examples['cases'][0]['response']['body']
future=copy.deepcopy(fixture)
future['future_optional']='compatible'
future['data']['future_optional']=True
probe.validate(future)
valid+=1
invalid=[]
for name in ['missing-data','missing-flag','string-flag','numeric-readiness','unsupported-version','empty-request-id','overlong-request-id','wrong-success']:
    data=copy.deepcopy(fixture)
    if name=='missing-data':del data['data']
    elif name=='missing-flag':del data['data']['mcp_enabled']
    elif name=='string-flag':data['data']['enabled']='true'
    elif name=='numeric-readiness':data['data']['runtime_ready']=1
    elif name=='unsupported-version':data['data']['schema_version']=2
    elif name=='empty-request-id':data['request_id']=''
    elif name=='overlong-request-id':data['request_id']='x'*65
    elif name=='wrong-success':data['success']=False
    assert list(probe.iter_errors(data)),name
    invalid.append(name)
assert schemas['AgentPlatformCapabilities']['properties']['runtime_ready']['type']=='boolean'
print(json.dumps({'scope':'Local JSON Schema components and development examples; not a complete OpenAPI conformance check','schema_components_valid':3,'examples_valid':3,'compatible_optional_case_valid':1,'invalid_cases_rejected':invalid,'total_cases':valid+len(invalid),'passed':valid+len(invalid)},ensure_ascii=False))
